description: The client asks for a model no account serves.

exceptions.reason: The old core answers an unknown model with 400 invalid_request_error (unknown provider, param model); the new core answers 404 model_not_found.
For an unknown model the old core says unknown provider (invalid_request_error, param model); the new core says no account serves the model (model_not_found).
